Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.client

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.client
Contains the Mesos client bootstrap classes.

This package hosts LaunchClient, the entry point that lets the user pick a user interface (JavaFX GUI or textual TUI) and a network technology (TCP or RMI) before the client starts. Subpackages provide the views (view.gui, view.tui), the server-facing proxies (serverproxy), and the client-side network endpoints (virtualserver).
